cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Jr. Cloud Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Your challenges and objectives:
Gain knowledge of [Company name masked]'s infrastructure and processes within the context of policies and compliance. Assist in building, implementing, and managing cloud-based infrastructure resources on both production and development environments. Learn and apply industry best practices in DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to automate solutions to challenges. Build professional relationships with our partners, supporting the strategic alignment of our cloud solutions with their unique needs. Collaborate with global colleagues, actively participating in a diverse and interconnected working environment.
Your day-to-day activities:
Contribute to the management and ownership of our corporate cloud-based infrastructure, working mostly with Linux. Support the implementation of changes in platforms using configuration management and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. Assist in overseeing the continual evolution of platforms, aligning priorities with stakeholders. Participate in developing and enhancing fail-proof techniques to ensure security, scalability, and resilience of workloads. Engage in projects aimed at adopting new technologies to meet the specific requirements of the public sector. Ensure round-the-clock coverage of service continuity by participating in flexible on-call shifts.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Be willing and eligible to be sponsored for [Location masked] government security clearance.
Experience in Linux system administration.
Exposure to private or public cloud platform development using current DevOps practices such as Containerization, Configuration Management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Troubleshooting mindset and eagerness to apply and develop problem-solving skills.
Preferred Requirements:
Enthusiastic about learning and growing in AWS cloud services proficiency.
Experience with specific technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Puppet, or Kubernetes.
Interest and curiosity in programming and automation, with a focus on creating efficient and streamlined processes, and a desire to eliminate repetitive tasks.
Interest in other essential cloud core services such as observability systems, web servers, and networking principles.

cond_0045.intro: We are looking for a Jr. Cloud Engineer to join our team, working alongside colleagues to support the unique needs of our public sector clients. This role involves collaborating on the deployment and maintenance of a secure, modern, and resilient cloud platform, and requires a willingness to work toward public certification programs.
cond_0045.responsibilities:
Your challenges and objectives:
Build familiarity with [Company name masked]'s infrastructure and processes within the context of policies and compliance. Work with the team to build, implement, and manage cloud-based infrastructure resources across production and development environments. Learn and apply industry best practices in DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to help automate solutions to challenges. Build working relationships with our partners, supporting the alignment of our cloud solutions with their needs. Coordinate with global colleagues, actively participating in a diverse and interconnected working environment.

Contribute to the shared management of our corporate cloud-based infrastructure, working mostly with Linux. Support the implementation of changes in platforms using configuration management and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. Participate in developing and enhancing fail-proof techniques to ensure security, scalability, and resilience of workloads. Work alongside the team on projects aimed at adopting new technologies to meet the specific requirements of the public sector. Help ensure round-the-clock coverage of service continuity by participating in flexible on-call shifts.

Experience in Linux system administration.

Troubleshooting mindset and eagerness to apply and develop problem-solving skills.
Preferred Requirements:
Enthusiasm for learning and growing in AWS cloud services proficiency.
Experience with specific technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Puppet, or Kubernetes.
Interest and curiosity in programming and automation, with a focus on creating efficient and streamlined processes and a desire to eliminate repetitive tasks.

cond_0162.responsibilities:
Your challenges and objectives:
Gain knowledge of [Company name masked]'s infrastructure and processes within the context of policies and compliance. Work alongside the team to build, implement, and manage cloud-based infrastructure resources on both production and development environments. Learn and apply industry best practices in DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to coordinate on automated solutions to challenges. Build professional relationships with our partners, supporting the alignment of our cloud solutions with their unique needs. Collaborate with global colleagues, actively participating in a diverse and interconnected working environment.
Your day-to-day activities:
Share responsibility for the management of our corporate cloud-based infrastructure, working mostly with Linux. Support the implementation of changes in platforms using configuration management and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. Help oversee the continual evolution of platforms, coordinating priorities with stakeholders. Participate in developing and enhancing fail-proof techniques to ensure security, scalability, and resilience of workloads. Work with the team on projects aimed at adopting new technologies to meet the specific requirements of the public sector. Help ensure round-the-clock coverage of service continuity by participating in flexible on-call shifts.
cond_0162.requirements: Be willing and eligible to be sponsored for [Location masked] government security clearance. Enthusiastic about learning and growing in AWS cloud services proficiency. Experience in Linux system administration. Exposure to private or public cloud platform development using current DevOps practices such as Containerization, Configuration Management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Experience with specific technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Puppet, or Kubernetes is a plus. Interest and curiosity in programming and automation, with a focus on creating efficient and streamlined processes, and a desire to eliminate repetitive tasks. Troubleshooting mindset and eagerness to apply and develop problem-solving skills. Interest in other essential cloud core services such as observability systems, web servers, and networking principles.

Gain knowledge of [Company name masked]'s infrastructure and processes within the context of policies and compliance. Enthusiastic about learning and growing in AWS cloud services proficiency.

cond_0415.intro: We are looking for a Jr. Cloud Engineer to join our team.
cond_0415.responsibilities:
Your challenges and objectives:
Gain knowledge of [Company name masked]'s infrastructure and processes within the context of policies and compliance. Assist in building, implementing, and managing cloud-based infrastructure resources on both production and development environments. Learn and apply industry best practices in DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to automate solutions to challenges. Build professional relationships with our partners, supporting the strategic alignment of our cloud solutions with their unique needs. Collaborate with global colleagues, actively participating in a diverse and interconnected working environment.
Your day-to-day activities:
Contribute to the management and ownership of our corporate cloud-based infrastructure, working mostly with Linux. Support the implementation of changes in platforms using configuration management and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. Assist in overseeing the continual evolution of platforms, aligning priorities with stakeholders. Participate in developing and enhancing fail-proof techniques to ensure security, scalability, and resilience of workloads. Engage in projects aimed at adopting new technologies to meet the specific requirements of the public sector. Ensure round-the-clock coverage of service continuity by participating in flexible on-call shifts.
cond_0415.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Be willing and eligible to be sponsored for [Location masked] government security clearance.
Experience in Linux system administration.
Exposure to private or public cloud platform development using current DevOps practices such as Containerization, Configuration Management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Troubleshooting mindset and eagerness to apply and develop problem-solving skills.
Preferred Requirements:
Enthusiastic about learning and growing in AWS cloud services proficiency.
Experience with specific technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Puppet, or Kubernetes.
Interest and curiosity in programming and automation, with a focus on creating efficient and streamlined processes, and a desire to eliminate repetitive tasks.
Interest in other essential cloud core services such as observability systems, web servers, and networking principles.
cond_0415.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.
